remarks: Do not miss the opportunity to invest in this prime piece of real estate located in Greenwich, CT at 2 homestead lane.  Greenwich Gate is a newly constructed condominium from 2005 complete with elevator, fitness center/gym, indoor parking garage and is in close proximity to town, parks, beaches, and perfect for commuting via train and highway. Unit 212 is situated as a corner unit on the second floor offering additional privacy, ample natural lighting and outdoor balcony.  Complete with granite counter tops, stainless steel kitchen appliances, breakfast bench and open spacious living room, this unit is perfectly suited for entertaining guests. This unit has two parking spaces both indoor garage and outside with close entry to building. Affordable monthly condo dues include Trash, Snow Removal, and ground maintenance. Original cabinets and appliances allow for any individual desired renovations. This space is ideal for anyone who wishes to make the condo their perfect forever home or looking to upgrade and sell in the future for further investment!
